messages.subject: How to label facets?
parts:
This is probably a simple question for ggplot2 buffs:

library(ggplot2)
type <- floor(rnorm(50,3,1))
year <- floor(rnorm(50,2002,1))
df <- data.frame(year=factor(year),type=factor(type))
qplot(data=df,year,geom="bar",facets=.~type)

The plot above shows a bar graph facetted by a factor called type,
which is derived from an integer. I'd like to assign labels to these
numerical types like "one", "two" .. such that they show up instead of
the numerical values (1, 2, ..) of the factor.

Another problem is that I cannot get rid of the "count" label on the y
axis since setting ylab does not work. (I believe several people had
reported this problem).

-- Christian

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: How to label facets?
parts: It's not pretty, but this will clear up those problems.

library(ggplot2)
type <- floor(rnorm(50,3,1))
year <- floor(rnorm(50,2002,1))
df   <- data.frame(year=factor(year),type=factor(type))

df$type <- factor(df$type)
levels(df$type) <- c('zero','one','two','three',
  'four','five')

  

qplot(year, data=df, geom = "bar", facets = . ~ type) +
  scale_y_continuous('')  

Hope it helps
david.
